source_limitations: Five Oxford publisher dictionary pages directly inspected via web text viewer on 2026-10-27. Page line locators are 0-based web-view lines and may shift. These observations establish dictionary meaning, POS, register and select topic labels; they do NOT independently certify the provisional C1 CEFR level, fluent Myanmar or example grammar. Meticulous has a separate Cambridge publisher search-indexed C2 lead; direct Cambridge access returned 403. Unrelated sidebar Word-of-the-Day CEFR labels are not headword labels.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Extremely careful about small details and accuracy.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: အသေးစိတ်အချက်များနှင့် တိကျမှုကို အလွန်ဂရုစိုက်သော
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Her meticulous records helped the auditors trace every payment.

publisher_source.observation: The Oxford entry describes detailed care and marks the Personal qualities topic c2; Cambridge Advanced Learner's search-indexed page labels the same careful-detail adjective C2. A topic label alone is not a headword CEFR assignment.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Check whether C1 teaching placement is defensible with exact-sense CEFR evidence; otherwise propose a separately reviewed C1 replacement. Independently verify Burmese and audit-record example grammar.

additional_publisher_evidence.sense_label: C2 careful attention to every detail
additional_publisher_evidence.limitation: Search-indexed Cambridge publisher excerpt only, not full direct page or independent human review

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Showing awareness of small but important differences.
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The report offers a nuanced view of migration patterns.

publisher_source.observation: Oxford describes subtle distinctions in meaning or expression. The draft's nuanced view of migration patterns is broadly consistent, but the page provides no entry-specific CEFR label; the unrelated Word-of-the-Day OPAL label must not be used.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Seek independent exact-sense C1 evidence and fluent Myanmar review; check that the example expresses complexity and subtle distinctions rather than merely a detailed report.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Very determined and unwilling to give up.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: အလွန်စိတ်ပိုင်းဖြတ်ထားပြီး အလွယ်တကူ လက်မလျှော့သော
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The tenacious researcher continued despite repeated setbacks.

publisher_source.observation: Oxford distinguishes determined refusal to give up (sense 1) from something persisting unexpectedly (sense 2). The draft researcher example fits determination; no word-specific CEFR label is shown on the page.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Review formal register, distinguish determined person from persistent illness, and obtain a separate sense-linked CEFR source for C1. The unrelated Oxford 5000 Word-of-the-Day card is not headword evidence.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: To make the harmful effects of something less serious.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: အရာတစ်ခု၏ ဆိုးကျိုးသက်ရောက်မှုများကို လျော့နည်းစေသည်
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Planting trees can help mitigate extreme summer heat.

publisher_source.observation: Oxford records a formal transitive verb meaning to lessen a harmful or serious effect, with objects such as impact or problem. The draft extreme-heat example fits the harm-reduction sense, but the entry does not assign a CEFR level.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Check if mitigating heat is semantically precise versus mitigating the harmful effects of heat; independently review the Myanmar verb gloss, original example and C1 level.

shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in large cities.

publisher_source.observation: Oxford describes something apparently everywhere or very common and marks formal/humorous register, usually attributive. The draft predicative 'have become ubiquitous' is grammatical in usage but needs independent naturalness review. An unrelated OPAL Word-of-the-Day card is not word-specific CEFR evidence.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Verify predicative use and Myanmar naturalness, then source C1 for the intended widespread-presence sense rather than relying on unrelated sidebar labels.
